question: Is Mathematics compulsory to attempt the qualifier?

answers.ds:
While the IITM BS team prefers candidates to have a foundation in Mathematics, Students should have Studied Maths and English in class 10. The program is designed to be inclusive of students from all academic backgrounds (Arts, Commerce, and Science).

How the Qualifier Works
The Qualifier Exam is not based on your prior school curriculum. Instead, it tests you on the first four weeks of coursework provided by the IITM BS program itself. These four weeks cover:

Mathematics for Data Science

Statistics for Data Science

Computational Thinking

English

As long as you thoroughly learn and understand the content provided during these four weeks of preparatory classes, you will have all the tools necessary to clear the Qualifier Exam, regardless of your previous mathematical background.
answers.ae: Yes. For the BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology programme, students must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics. If they passed Class 12 without Physics and Mathematics but passed Physics and Mathematics separately through NIOS or another equivalent organization, they may be permitted to apply after committee approval.
answers.mg: Yes. For the BS in Management and Data Science programme, students should have studied Maths and English in Class 10.
answers.es: Yes. For the BS in Electronic Systems programme, students must have passed Class 12 or equivalent with Physics and Mathematics. If they passed Class 12 without Physics and Mathematics but passed Physics and Mathematics separately through NIOS or another equivalent organization, they may be permitted to apply after committee approval.

question: What is the overall structure of the program? What are Levels?

answers.ds:
The program is split into three levels that have to be done strictly in sequence:
1: Foundational Level (8 courses)
2: Diploma Level (6 Programming courses + 6 Data Science courses)
3: Degree Level (11 courses)

Check [Overall Structure] in Academics page.
answers.ae: The BS in Aeronautics and Space Technology programme has multiple levels and exit options. Depending on the courses completed and credits earned, learners can receive a Foundation Certificate from IITM CODE, a Diploma from IIT Madras, or a BS Degree from IIT Madras.
answers.mg:
The program is split into three levels that have to be done strictly in sequence:
1: Foundation Level (8 courses)
2: Diploma Level (14 courses + 2 Projects)
3: Degree Level (6 Core courses + electives)

Check [Overall Structure] in Academics page.
answers.es:
The program is split into three levels that have to be done strictly in sequence:
1: Foundation Level: 43 credits | 9 Theory courses + 5 Labs
2: Diploma Level: 43 credits | 8 Theory + 3 Labs + 2 Project courses
3: BS Degree Level: 56 credits | 12 courses + 1 Lab + Electives
Check Overall Structure in [Academics] page.

question: How long will it take to complete the online degree program if I am working?

answers.ds:
We expect full time students (students who are pursuing BS Degree as Sole Degree) to complete the BS degree within 4 years while those pursuing the BS degree in parallel with another physical college degree program or while working can comfortably complete the BS degree in 5-6 years.

While this is the estimated time till BS degree, a diploma can potentially be obtained around 2 years. Check [Academics] page to better understand the program structure.
answers.ae: The programme is flexible and allows students to progress at their own pace. The minimum duration to complete the degree is 4 years, and the maximum permitted duration is 8 years.
answers.mg: Full-time students are expected to complete the BS degree within 4 years, while learners pursuing it alongside another physical college degree or while working can comfortably complete it in 5-8 years. A diploma can potentially be obtained around 2 years.
answers.es: This BS degree is a 4 year program. On an average, we anticipate that a learner studying part time will finish the degree in 4 to 8 years. Check [Acadmics] page to better understand the program structure.

question: What is the Qualifier Exam?

answers.ds: The Qualifier Exam is part of the regular entry route into the Foundation Level. Applicants go through a 4-week qualifier process with content from four Foundation level courses for DS: English 1, Maths-1, Statistics-1, and Computational Thinking. At the end of the 4 weeks, eligible candidates take a qualifier exam based on that content; passing it makes them eligible to proceed with Foundation level registration
answers.ae:
The Qualifier Exam is part of the admission process. It includes four weeks of preparatory coursework delivered through the online portal. The coursework consists of lecture videos, weekly graded assignments, and live sessions from the following Foundation-level courses: English I, Mathematics I, ESTC, and C Programming.

Students must submit weekly graded assignments for each course. In each course, the average of the best 2 out of the first 3 assignment scores will be calculated. Only students who achieve the minimum required average in all four courses will be eligible to appear for the Qualifier Exam, which will be conducted at the end of the four-week preparatory period.
answers.mg: The Qualifier Exam is part of the regular entry route into the BS in Management and Data Science programme. Applicants go through a 4-week qualifier process with content from four Foundation level courses: English 1, Maths-1, Statistics-1, and Computational Thinking. At the end of the 4 weeks, eligible candidates take a qualifier exam based on that content.
answers.es: The Qualifier Exam is part of the regular entry route into the BS in Electronic Systems programme. Applicants go through a 4-week qualifier process with content from four Foundation level courses: English 1, Maths for Electronics - 1, Electronic Systems Thinking and Circuits, and Introduction to C Programming. At the end of the 4 weeks, eligible candidates take a qualifier exam based on that content.
